subject: Request: Custom invoicing cadence + extended payment window for Hearthlight
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@hearthlight.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@hearthlight.io>, Hearthlight Legal <legal@hearthlight.io>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment cadence request for pilot agreement

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move the pilot forward. A couple of constraints from our finance and grants team: we operate on quarterly billing cycles and have limited working capital in the current fiscal quarter.

Two asks to get procurement moving:
- Can Redwood invoice quarterly rather than monthly?
- Would you accept a Net-90 payment window (we can provide a purchase order and reference to grant funding timelines)?

There is budget for the pilot but approvals depend on those terms. Also curious if any partner/strategic discount exists for early-stage pilots.

Appreciate your help — want to get SOW signed this month.

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
Director of Operations, Hearthlight Analytics
Sanjay Patel | Hearthlight Analytics
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@hearthlight.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment cadence request for pilot agreement

Hi Sanjay — great to hear, and glad the demo was helpful. Quick responses to your points: 

- Quarterly invoicing: yes, we can invoice on a quarterly cadence for pilots (we'll flag for accounting).
- Net-90: that's outside our standard terms and requires an executive approval for extended credit.

We're open to a pilot-friendly pricing concession. I can propose a conditional structure to speed approvals:
- Quarterly invoicing as you requested.
- Net-60 by default; we can escalate Net-90 request for exec review.
- Strategic pilot discount: 5% standard, up to 10% subject to exec sign-off and milestone-based payments.

I'll loop in sales ops and finance to document the exact tradeoffs (discount vs. credit window). Can you confirm the expected first invoice amount and whether Hearthlight can do a partial up-front remittance? Even a 25-30% initial payment materially reduces our risk and makes Net-90 more palatable.

I'll escalate formally to our deal desk and finance team.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hearthlight payment cadence — pricing + risk note

Forwarding Sanjay's ask — summary and recommended options attached (Pricing_Term_Summary.xlsx).

Quick recommended options for deal desk:
1) Standard compromise (low risk): Quarterly invoicing + Net-60; 5% strategic discount.
2) Exec-approved (medium risk): Quarterly invoicing + Net-75; 7.5% discount; 30% initial remittance within 14 days of SOW signature.
3) High concession (requires CFO/CSO signoff): Quarterly invoicing + Net-90; 10% discount; escrow or irrevocable PO; legal to sign amended payment addendum.

Please advise finance and leadership which option to approve. If finance wants to mitigate credit risk we should convert to milestone-based invoicing with the first milestone invoiced immediately.

Attachments: Pricing_Term_Summary.xlsx (breakdown of discount impact on ARR, expected DSO change).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hearthlight payment cadence — finance perspective

Thanks for the summary. From finance: Net-90 materially increases DSO and cash risk for this segment (pilot, new customer). We can consider a middle-ground but need explicit safeguards. My recommendation: approve option 2 conditionally — Net-75 + 7.5% discount — only if Hearthlight agrees to one of the following (choose one):

- 30% initial remittance within 14 days of SOW signature (applies to first invoice), OR
- Irrevocable PO + confirmed grant funding reference + legal addendum, OR
- Escrow deposit equal to first-quarter invoice.

If leadership prefers a larger commercial concession (10% + Net-90) we need CFO sign-off and a signed payment addendum. Please escalate to Marissa for exec approval.

Avery Johnson
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Avery Johnson <avery@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hearthlight payment cadence — final approval (conditional)

Thanks team — reviewed the risk/impact. Approve a conditional concession to close this pilot:

Approved terms (final):
- Invoicing cadence: Quarterly (as requested).
- Payment window: Net-75 (exception to standard).
- Strategic discount: 5% applied to pilot invoices.
- Credit safeguard: Hearthlight must remit 30% of the first invoice within 14 days of SOW signature. If the 30% remittance is not received, terms revert to Net-60 and discount removed.
- Required paperwork: add a short Payment Addendum to the SOW documenting Net-75 and the 30% upfront obligation. Legal to draft.

Logan — please communicate these terms to Sanjay and get written acceptance. Karthik, update the deal in HubSpot (DL-2026-8421) and attach the Pricing_Term_Summary and SOW v3 with the payment addendum. Finance will monitor collection closely during the pilot.

Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Revenue — Redwood Inference
